page_title: AskCodi, an AI agency that builds and runs your software

sources.entry: AskCodi - Code generation and refactoring assistant. #free

summary.name: AskCodi
summary.one_liner: AskCodi is an AI agency service that scopes, builds, and maintains software for you in a GitHub repository you own, with changes presented for your sign-off.
use_cases: Scope and build a new app idea from scratch
Maintain an existing product connected to GitHub
Triage production errors and open pull requests
Keep documentation in sync after merges
Use an OpenAI-compatible API gateway for AI models
summary.what_it_does: AskCodi takes a goal and returns a written scope before work starts, then breaks the work into visible tasks and delivers each piece for sign-off. For new ideas it writes scope and system design before code. For existing products it connects to a GitHub repository, reads how the code runs and is checked, and proposes recurring maintenance work called plays. Code changes are made on branches, with the repository's checks needing to pass before a change is called ready. The page also describes AI Gateway, a standalone product usable from any OpenAI-compatible SDK with an AskCodi API key.
notable: Work is kept in a GitHub repository the user owns, with changes on branches and pull requests
Spending is capped by a balance or run cap the user sets, and money, scope, and destructive actions return to the user first
Free tier of 300,000 tokens a day with no card required; paid plans return their full price as tokens
Standing plays are recurring maintenance outcomes that run to an approved pattern and leave receipts
caveats: Paid plans ($29, $99, $199 tiers) are required to scale beyond the free tier, and plans scale by number of apps
Autonomous work is limited to the pattern the user approves in a supervised pilot; new scope and money decisions return to the user
Requires a GitHub repository for code work
